statement: The distributed strategy extracted from a positional sequential strategy is finite-state; for safety/parity CDM games this yields a gossip-based memory automaton with distributed memory bounded by (max_i |S_i|)^{|P|} * max_i |V_i|.
architecture_assumptions: single central decision maker participates in every nondeterministic action
process_bound: finite but unbounded number of processes
